oneLine: aex is an agent execution platform for launching autonomous agents from a simple TypeScript SDK and CLI.
description: Open durable agent sessions, send turns, stream events, capture files, and compose agents with skills, files, MCP, secrets, networking controls, and subagents across the managed runtime.

alpha.label: Alpha testing
alpha.description: Access is limited to invited testers while we harden the hosted runtime, dashboard, and SDK workflows.

featureAreas.title: Agent runtime
featureAreas.description: Managed autonomous sessions with filesystem read/edit, grep/glob/head/tail, open web fetch/search, background commands, code execution, git, and subagents.

featureAreas.title: Durable infrastructure
featureAreas.description: Resumable session lifecycle, explicit run outcomes, committed checkpoints, idempotency, typed events, file capture, downloads, timeouts, and runtime sizes.

featureAreas.title: Agent composition
featureAreas.description: Version-pinned skills, files, custom tools, instructions, remote MCP servers, environment variables, secrets, and networking controls.

featureAreas.title: Subagents
featureAreas.description: Typed parent/child lineage for async child sessions, file handoff, and bounded agent delegation.

featureAreas.title: Managed model access
featureAreas.description: Name any model by its Vercel AI Gateway `creator/model` slug — the platform's managed key routes it. No provider selection, no provider API keys.

featureAreas.title: Typed control surface
featureAreas.description: Strongly typed SDK inputs, CLI parity, workspace secrets, redaction, assistant text modes, and file capture policy.
